question: How does the mobile anti-aircraft gun look? Alex's second mission profile (decision suppress-mission): 'Clear mobile Aa units and their escorts to enable a bombing run of a military complex.'
source: scripts/ui/boards/mobile_aa_board_shot.gd: the new generator scripts/ui/unit_marker_art_mobile_aa.gd drawn through the game's own markers (scripts/ui/unit_marker.gd) and baked art (unit_marker_art.gd) by scripts/ui/boards/m2_frame.gd, on the game's own paper and road; no sandbox is stood up and nothing in the game changes but the art cache

held_constant.scale: the sandbox's plane rule (a light fighter 36 px across at zoom 1, never under 14 px): the vehicle about 4 px per metre at zoom 1, 8 at zoom 2 and 1.6 at the planning zoom 0.35; the battery at twice that (marker.static_scale 2)
held_constant.light: the map's sun (north-west, elevation 46, shadow strength 0.44), one merged shadow tint
held_constant.pen: the game's own pen (render_defaults linework.pen, shadow side)
held_constant.accent: one zone per look in the side's colour: the enemy's slate blue (side_b) on most frames, the players' brick red (side_a) on one vehicle in the zoom-1 and zoom-2 frames
held_constant.beside: a tank and the anti-aircraft battery, the game's own, at the same zoom
held_constant.data_that_changes_between_options: ui.json unit_art.variant.mobile_aa (the look index) and nothing else

parameter: data/ui/unit_art_mission2.json mobile_aa.default_look (PROPOSED: 0, the half-track) until Alex picks; ui.json unit_art.variant.mobile_aa overrides it once the pick is made

options.name: A
options.title: Half-track with a quad mount
options.description: The narrowest and longest of the three: a cab and bonnet over two front wheels, two short tracks at the back, and an open gun bed with a four-barrel mount whose barrels are drawn raised and foreshortened over the cab. The accent is a recognition panel on the cab roof.

options.name: B
options.title: Tracked hull with an open twin turret
options.description: The nearest to the tank: a wide tracked hull with the engine deck at the back, but the turret is an open-topped eight-sided tub with the crew's heads in it, and the weapon is a pair of barrels drawn raised and foreshortened with flash hiders. The accent is the engine-deck panel, as on the tank.

options.name: C
options.title: Light carrier with a ring mount
options.description: The battery that moves: a short tracked carrier with a cab block at the front and a flat rear deck holding a round armour ring (the battery's sandbag ring in steel) round a pedestal mount with twin barrels, with ammunition crates beside it. The accent is a panel on the deck behind the ring.

shadow_rule.before: the marker layer's shadow offset for a unit at the surface was 0: a ground vehicle's shadow was under it (the tank's too)
shadow_rule.now: ui.json marker.cast_shadow_on (PROPOSED, on) lifts a surface unit's shadow by its marker.cast_height_m (tank 2.0 m, mobile_aa 2.4 m, PROPOSED) x the sun's length away from the sun; the planes, the tower and the battery are untouched
shadow_rule.question_for_alex: keep ground vehicles casting a shadow by that rule (it is on)? The heights are proposed.

palette_check: No option adds a hue. The hull is the object fill (L 0.925) a step off the paper (L 0.847); tracks and tyres the rock fill (L 0.887); the windscreen the planes' glass roles; a shaded face the one mix toward the shadow tint; the accent zone the side's colour (side_b L 0.551 C 0.100, side_a L 0.551 C 0.100: equal lightness and chroma). Material is linework.
recommendation_proposed: A, the half-track, as the working default (PROPOSED by Track M2U, Alex decides): it is the look least like the tank at the planning zoom (a long narrow bar against a squat block), and a half-track with a quad mount is the vehicle people picture for the job. C is the one that tells what it does fastest (the battery's ring), at the price of the smallest accent. B is the likeliest to be taken for a tank, which could be wanted (it is a hull the tank track can draw from) or not (the player is meant to find and hunt it).
sheet: board.png (each look at the planning zoom 1:1 and 3x, zoom 1 and zoom 2 beside a tank and the battery; the shadow rule; a palette strip)
chosen: A, the half-track with a quad mount (Alex 2026-10-11: 'I like the half track with quad Mount')
